name: Algebraic Clause Obfuscation
description: Translates the DIMACS 2-SAT clause condition (not both literals false) into a single algebraic inequality: x * s_{|x|} + y * s_{|y|} > min(x, 0) + min(y, 0). This removes all textual hints of boolean logic, signs, and satisfiability, forcing the model to algebraically deduce the minimum bounds of the terms to recognize the underlying 2-SAT structure.
